name: 85304 · Glendale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85304 (Glendale) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85304 (Glendale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85304 (Glendale) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
